onboard.disclaimer: ShramikSathi helps you understand your rights under The Labour Act, 2017 (Nepal). It is not legal advice.

results.title: Your results
results.found: We found {count} item(s) to look at
results.noViolationsDesc: Based on what you told us, your working conditions appear to meet the minimum standards in the Act. If something changes, come back and check again.
results.actPrevails: Important: even if your contract says otherwise, the law wins (§3(2)).
results.deadline: Filing deadline: 6 months from the date of the violation
results.pathway1: Write to your employer first (§113) — they have 15 days to respond.
results.pathway2: If there's no response, apply to the Labour Office for mediation (§114) — they act within 21 days.
results.pathway3: If unresolved, the Labour Office decides on the evidence (§115).
results.pathway4: You can appeal a decision to the Labour Court within 35 days (§165).
results.script: Sample conversation script (AI-generated suggestion, not legal advice)
results.script.hello: Namaste, I wanted to raise something about my work conditions.
results.script.ask: Could we fix this? I'd like to resolve it together.
results.script.note: Keep a copy of this conversation. If nothing changes within a couple of weeks, you can file a complaint with the Labour Office within 6 months of the violation.

sign.title: Review & sign
sign.subtitle: Review your day's record before it is sent to your employer for approval.
sign.intro: By signing you confirm this record is true and accurate. Your digital signature is created with an asymmetric cryptosystem under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2063 (2008) and protects this record from tampering.
sign.verifyNote: A tamper-proof hash of this record is created and stored. If anyone changes it later, the signature will no longer match.
sign.agree: I confirm this record is accurate and true.
sign.sentDesc: Your signed record is now waiting for {employer} to review and sign it.
sign.approvedDesc: Both you and your employer signed this record. The approved record is a strong digital record.
sign.rejectedDesc: Your employer did not approve this record.
sign.editHint: If the employer rejected the record because of a mistake, correct it here and send it again.
sign.verifyOk: Both signatures verified — this record is intact.
sign.verifyBad: Signature check failed. This record may have been altered.
sign.legal.title: Employer not approving a correct record?
sign.legal.p1: Your signed record is admissible digital evidence under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2063 (2008) and the Evidence Act, 2031 (1974).
sign.legal.p2: You can file a complaint with your district Labour Office, or the Department of Labour and Occupational Safety, under the Labour Act, 2074. Ask the employer in writing why the record was rejected.
sign.legal.bullet1: File a written complaint at your district Labour Office.
sign.legal.bullet2: Bring your signed record from this app as evidence — it is a digitally signed document.
sign.legal.bullet3: The Labour Act, 2074 requires employers to keep true wage records; refusing to approve a true record can be raised in your complaint.
sign.legal.bullet4: If wages remain unpaid after the due date, the law provides for interest and compensation.
logs.legalBody: Your signed record is valid digital evidence. If the employer refuses to approve a correct record, you can file a complaint at your district Labour Office under the Labour Act, 2074.
employer.rejectReasonHint: Short message to the worker, e.g. a mistake to fix.
employer.agreeIntro: By approving you confirm this record is true and accurate, and you are signing it as the employer. Your digital signature is created with an asymmetric cryptosystem under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2063 (2008) and is valid under the Labour Act, 2074.
employer.agreeNote: A tamper-proof hash of this record is created and stored. If anyone changes it later, the signature will no longer match.
employer.agree: I agree this record is accurate and true, and I am signing it in accordance with the Labour Act, 2074.
employer.verifyFailed: The worker's signature could not be verified on this record.
employer.rejectSuccess: Record rejected. The worker can edit and resend it.
employer.approveSuccess: Record approved and signed by you.
